---
title: "Was könnte man stattdessen kaufen?"
subtitle: "Militär- vs. Sozialausgaben in Österreich"

Staatsausgaben spiegeln politische Prioritäten wider. Diese Visualisierung stellt ausgewählten Militärausgaben gegenüber, wie viel davon mit demselben Budget im Sozialbereich finanziert werden könnte. Oben steht eine <span style="color: #D62021; font-weight: bold;">Militärausgabe</span>, darunter die Anzahl der <span style="color: #237BBD; font-weight: bold;">Sozialausgaben</span>, die mit demselben Budget möglich wären. Mit den Auswahlmenüs lassen sich verschiedene Kombinationen vergleichen.

Vorsichtig: Aktuell keine echten Daten!

```{ojs}
makeIsoline = (params = {}) => {
  const {
    data = null,
    vizWidth = width,
    cellWidth = 18,
    cellHeight = 100,
    personWidth = 10,
    personHeight = 100,
    persPerLineValue = Math.floor(vizWidth / cellWidth) - 1,
    defaultShapes = "abcdefghilmnopqSBDEGHIJKLNOPRSTVWXYZ",
    defaultFillHighlight = "steelblue",
    defaultFillNormal = "#ddd",
    randomOrder = true,  // true for random, false for sequential
    groupByKey = false,  // true to group subkeys under each key
    showPercentage = true
  } = params;

  // Group data by key if groupByKey is true
  const dataGroups = groupByKey
    ? Array.from(d3.group(data, d => d.key), ([key, items]) => ({ key, items }))
    : data.map(item => ({ key: item.key, items: [item] }));

  // Create rows for each group
  const rows = dataGroups.map((group, groupIndex) => {
    const groupRows = group.items.map((item, rowIndex) => {
    const highlightValue = item.value;
    const shapes = item.shapes || defaultShapes;
    const fillHighlight = item.fillHighlight || defaultFillHighlight;
    const fillNormal = item.fillNormal || defaultFillNormal;
    const subkey = item.subkey ?? "Personen";
    const rowPersPerLine = item.persPerLine !== undefined ? item.persPerLine : persPerLineValue;
    const highlightCountValue = Math.round(rowPersPerLine * highlightValue);

    // Generate person with custom alphabet
    const generatePersonCustom = seed => {
      const avatarChoices = shapes;
      const id = "person_" + d3.format("0>4")(seed) + "_row" + rowIndex;
      const avatar = randomOrder
        ? avatarChoices[parseInt(md5(id).slice(0, 2), 16) % avatarChoices.length]
        : avatarChoices[seed % avatarChoices.length];
      return {
        id,
        avatar,
        highlight: seed < highlightCountValue ? true : false
      };
    };

    // Render person with custom colors
    const renderPersonCustom = (p) => {
      const fillColor = p.highlight ? fillHighlight : fillNormal;
      const strokeColor = "#fff";

      return svg`
        <g class="person">
          <text y="0"
            style="font-size: ${personHeight}px; font-family: Isotype"
            fill="${fillColor}"
            stroke="${strokeColor}"
            stroke-width="3">
            ${p.avatar}
          </text>

        <text y="0"
          style="font-size: ${personHeight}px; font-family: Isotype;"
          fill="${fillColor}">
            ${p.avatar}
        </text>
        </g>
      `;
    };

    // Create the SVG visualization for this row
    const people = d3.range(rowPersPerLine).map(generatePersonCustom);
    const height = cellHeight;

    const vizSvg = html`
      <svg width="${vizWidth}" height="${height}">
        <g transform="translate(0, ${Math.round(personHeight * 0.95)})">
          ${people.map((p, i) => ({ p, i })).reverse().map(
            ({ p, i }) => svg`
            <g transform="translate(${i * cellWidth}, 0)">
              ${renderPersonCustom(p)}
            </g>`
          )}
        </g>
      </svg>
    `;

    // Create the label span
    const percentageText = html`
      <span style="color: ${fillHighlight}; font-family: League Spartan; font-weight: 280;">
        ${subkey}
      </span>
    `;

    // Return row with label
    return html`
      <div style="margin-bottom: 0px;">
        ${groupByKey && rowIndex === 0 ? html`<h3 style="font-family: League Spartan; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px 0;">${group.key}</h3>` : html``}
        ${!groupByKey ? html`<h3 style="font-family: League Spartan; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 12px 0;">${item.key}</h3>` : html``}
        ${showPercentage ? percentageText : html``}
        ${vizSvg}
      </div>
    `;
    });

    // Return group container
    return html`
      <div style="margin-bottom: ${groupByKey ? '0px' : '0px'};">
        ${groupRows}
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // Return all rows in a container
  return html`
    <div style="margin: 24px 0 0 0">
      ${rows}
    </div>
  `;
}
```

```{ojs}
ausgaben_data = FileAttachment("data/data_long.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectMilitaer = {
  const form = Inputs.select(
    ausgaben_data.filter(d => d.ausgabenart === "Militärausgabe").map(d => d.name),
    { label: "Militärausgabe: " }
  );
  const sel = form.querySelector("select");
  const wrapper = document.createElement("span");
  wrapper.className = "select-wrapper select-wide select-militaer";
  const arrow = document.createElement("span");
  arrow.className = "select-arrow";
  arrow.innerHTML = "&#9662;";
  sel.replaceWith(wrapper);
  wrapper.appendChild(sel);
  wrapper.appendChild(arrow);
  form.classList.add("select-form-main");
  return form;
}

viewof selectSozial = {
  const form = Inputs.select(
    ausgaben_data.filter(d => d.ausgabenart === "Sozialausgabe").map(d => d.name),
    { label: "Sozialausgabe: " }
  );
  const sel = form.querySelector("select");
  const wrapper = document.createElement("span");
  wrapper.className = "select-wrapper select-wide select-sozial";
  const arrow = document.createElement("span");
  arrow.className = "select-arrow";
  arrow.innerHTML = "&#9662;";
  sel.replaceWith(wrapper);
  wrapper.appendChild(sel);
  wrapper.appendChild(arrow);
  form.classList.add("select-form-main");
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
militaerMio = ausgaben_data.find(d => d.name === selectMilitaer)?.ausgaben_mio || 0
militaer_viz = [{ key: "Militärausgabe", subkey: "1 " + selectMilitaer + " (" + militaerMio + " Mio. €)", value: 1, shapes: getShapes(selectMilitaer), fillHighlight: "#D62021", fillNormal: "#e8d5d5" }]
```

```{ojs}
sozialMio = ausgaben_data.find(d => d.name === selectSozial)?.ausgaben_mio || 0
sozial_viz = {
  const iconsTotal = Math.round(sozialMio > 0 ? militaerMio / sozialMio : 0);
  const lineSize = 50;
  const shapes = getShapes(selectSozial);
  const label = iconsTotal + " " + selectSozial + " (1 = " + sozialMio + " Mio. €)";
  const numFullLines = Math.floor(iconsTotal / lineSize);
  const rem = iconsTotal % lineSize;

  const lines = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < numFullLines; i++) {
    lines.push({ key: "Sozialausgabe", subkey: i === 0 ? label : "", value: 1, persPerLine: lineSize, shapes, fillHighlight: "#237BBD", fillNormal: "#d5dce3" });
  }
  if (rem > 0) {
    lines.push({ key: "Sozialausgabe", subkey: lines.length === 0 ? label : "", value: 1, persPerLine: rem, shapes, fillHighlight: "#237BBD", fillNormal: "#d5dce3" });
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) {
    lines.push({ key: "Sozialausgabe", subkey: "0 " + selectSozial, value: 0, persPerLine: 1, shapes, fillHighlight: "#237BBD", fillNormal: "#d5dce3" });
  }
  return lines;
}
```

```{ojs .mainViz}
{
  const colMilitaer = 260;
  const gap = 32;
  const marginRight = 24;
  const colSozial = width - colMilitaer - gap - marginRight;
  const cw = width > 600 ? 23 : 28;

  const militaer = makeIsoline({
    data: militaer_viz,
    vizWidth: colMilitaer,
    persPerLineValue: 1,
    cellWidth: cw,
    randomOrder: true,
    groupByKey: false,
    showPercentage: true
  });

  const sozial = makeIsoline({
    data: sozial_viz,
    vizWidth: colSozial,
    cellWidth: 18,
    cellHeight: 80,
    personHeight: 80,
    randomOrder: true,
    groupByKey: true,
    showPercentage: true
  });

  return html`
    <div style="display: flex; gap: ${gap}px; align-items: flex-start;">
      <div style="flex: 0 0 ${colMilitaer}px; margin-right: ${marginRight}px;">${militaer}</div>
      <div style="flex: 1;">${sozial}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
